instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'framer-motion' for all entrance and interaction animations.
Implement 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., 'Copied to clipboard', 'Code generated').
Use 'lucide-react' for icons (Clipboard, Upload, Smartphone, QrCode, Copy, Check).
For the QRCode, use 'react-qr-code' or a similar lightweight library.
Ensure the 'Receiver' input auto-formats to uppercase.
The 'Generate Code' action should trigger a confetti effect or a satisfying 'success' animation.
Use the provided 'hero_bg' as a subtle background texture (opacity-5 or opacity-10) for the main section.
CRITICAL: Do not use gradients for the main background. Keep it clean slate/white.
CRITICAL: Ensure drag-and-drop zone feels tactile (border-dashed border-2 hover:border-indigo-500 hover:bg-indigo-50/50).
Use strict Z-index management to ensure toasts appear above everything.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts for everything. Use asymmetry where possible.
Use Tailwind's 'group' and 'group-hover' for complex interaction states.
